name: Futaba (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Futaba town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom with two curled ends, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Futaba, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 September 1985; the emblem dates from 1 October 1972.

features.role: Futaba town emblem — a ring open at the bottom with two curled ends, like a stylised character
